==Overview==
Nineteen clubs participated, and [[Galatasaray S.K. (football team)|Galatasaray S.K.]] won the championship.

==Controversy==
In March 2020, statements from former Denizlispor player Mesut Bakkal’s autobiography, which he later said had been prepared for family and close friends and not for commercial publication, came to public attention.

Bakkal stated that Denizlispor players had been given [[Doping in sport|doping]] substances and incentive bonuses ({{lang|tr|Teşvik primleri}}) before their penultimate league match against [[Beşiktaş J.K.]]<ref name="GazeteFutbol-01">{{cite web |date=11 March 2020 |title=Mesut Bakkal: „Wir haben von Galatasaray eine Motivationsprämie erhalten!“ |url=https://gazetefutbol.de/mesut-bakkal-wir-haben-von-galatasaray-eine-ermutigungspraemie-erhalten/ |trans-title=Mesut Bakkal: “We’ve received a incentive bonus from Galatasaray!” |website=GazeteFutbol.de (Online) |language=de |access-date=29 May 2026}}</ref> The match ended in a 1–1 draw, and Galatasaray later won the championship by one point ahead of Beşiktaş.<ref name="GazeteFutbol-01">{{cite web |date=11 March 2020 |title=Mesut Bakkal: „Wir haben von Galatasaray eine Motivationsprämie erhalten!“ |url=https://gazetefutbol.de/mesut-bakkal-wir-haben-von-galatasaray-eine-ermutigungspraemie-erhalten/ |trans-title=Mesut Bakkal: “We’ve received a incentive bonus from Galatasaray!” |website=GazeteFutbol.de (Online) |language=de |access-date=29 May 2026}}</ref><ref name="LigaBlatt-01">{{cite web |date=March 2020 |title=Bakkal-Beichten: Beşiktaş stellt Antrag auf den Meisterschaftstitel von 1987 |url=https://www.ligablatt.de/besiktas/bakkal-beichten-besiktas-stellt-antrag-auf-den-meisterschaftstitel-von-1987/ |trans-title=Bakkal's Confessions: Beşiktaş submits a claim for the 1987 championship title |website=LigaBlatt.de (Online) |language=de |access-date=29 May 2026}}</ref>

Following Bakkal's statements, Beşiktaş officially requested that the [[Turkish Football Federation]] (TFF) retroactively award the club a 3–0 victory in the match and recognize Beşiktaş as the 1986–87 Turkish champions.<ref name="LigaBlatt-01">{{cite web |date=March 2020 |title=Bakkal-Beichten: Beşiktaş stellt Antrag auf den Meisterschaftstitel von 1987 |url=https://www.ligablatt.de/besiktas/bakkal-beichten-besiktas-stellt-antrag-auf-den-meisterschaftstitel-von-1987/ |trans-title=Bakkal's Confessions: Beşiktaş submits a claim for the 1987 championship title |website=LigaBlatt.de (Online) |language=de |access-date=29 May 2026}}</ref><ref name="GazeteFutbol-02">{{cite web |date=13 March 2020 |title=Der Bakkal-Effekt: Besiktas will Zusprechung des Meistertitels der Saison 1986/87 |url=https://gazetefutbol.de/der-bakkal-effekt-besiktas-will-zusprechung-des-meistertitels-der-saison-1986-87/ |trans-title=The Bakkal Effect: Beşiktaş seeks to be awarded the 1986-87 championship title |website=GazeteFutbol.de (Online) |language=de |access-date=29 May 2026}}</ref> Bakkal defended the incentive bonus payments by stating that they had not been prohibited by TFF regulations at the time.<ref name="AnadoluAjansi-01">{{cite web |date=11 March 2020 |title=Mesut Bakkal'dan 'teşvik primi' savunması |url=https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/futbol/mesut-bakkaldan-tesvik-primi-savunmasi/1762254 |trans-title=Mesut Bakkal defends the 'incentive bonus' |website=[[Anadolu Ajansi|AA]].com.tr (Online) |language=tr |access-date=29 May 2026}}</ref>

In June 2020, the TFF rejected Beşiktaş's request on the grounds of the [[Statute of limitations|statute of limitations]].<ref>{{cite web |date=29 June 2020 |title=TFF'den Beşiktaş'ın 1986/1987 sezonuna ilişkin yaptığı itiraza ret  |url=https://haberglobal.com/spor/tff-den-besiktas-in-1986-1987-sezonuna-iliskin-itirazina-ret-55389 |trans-title=The Turkish Football Federation has rejected Beşiktaş’s appeal regarding the 1986–1987 season |website=HaberGlobal.com.tr (Online) |language=tr |access-date=29 May 2026}}</ref>

Galatasaray disputed the allegations and stated that the claims were "baseless accusations" aimed at damaging the club's history and reputation. The club also announced that legal action had been initiated regarding the statements made in Bakkal's book.<ref>{{cite web |date=28 May 2020 |title=Galatasaray'dan Mesut Bakkal'ın yazdığı kitap hakkında suç duyurusu |url=https://www.ahaber.com.tr/spor/2020/05/28/galatasaraydan-mesut-bakkalin-yazdigi-kitap-hakkinda-suc-duyurusu |trans-title=Galatasaray has filed a criminal complaint regarding the book written by Mesut Bakkal |website=[[A Haber|AHaber]].com.tr (Online) |language=tr |access-date=25 May 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |date=1 June 2020 |title=Galatasaray: Rakibimizi geçmişten kupa çıkartma çabalarını bir kenara bırakarak, saha içerisinde şampiyonluk kazanmaya davet ediyoruz |url=https://t24.com.tr/spor/galatasaray-rakibimizi-gecmisten-kupa-cikartma-cabalarini-bir-kenara-birakarak-saha-icerisinde-sampiyonluk-kazanmaya-davet-ediyoruz,881784?_t=1780011643847 |trans-title=Galatasaray: We invite our opponent to put aside their past attempts to win trophies and instead focus on winning the championship on the field. |website=[[T24 (newspaper)|T24]].com.tr (Online) |language=tr |access-date=29 May 2026}}</ref>

Beşiktaş responded by defending its application to the TFF and stated that the matter should be evaluated by the federation rather than through public accusations between clubs.<ref>{{cite web |date=3 June 2020 |title=Beşiktaş'tan Galatasaray'a yanıt: 'Talihsizliktir' |url=https://www.hurriyet.com.tr/sporarena/son-dakika-besiktastan-galatasaraya-yanit-talihsizliktir-41533395 |trans-title=Beşiktaş responds to Galatasaray: 'It's unfortunate.' |website=[[Hürriyet|Hurriyet]].com.tr (Online) |language=tr |access-date=29 May 2026}}</ref>
